'''Erkas Andrakles''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Astrocartography|astrocartographer]] during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. After being expelled from the [[Grand Astrocartographic Institute]], he found work as an astrocartographer for several large corporations before setting out on his own. Andrakles claimed to have found a crashed ship on the planet [[J't'p'tan]], which was made of a coral-like substance, and was of organic nature. Years later, it was assumed that Andrakles' ship was a [[Yorik-et|coralskipper]], once used by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]].
